svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print one, lid down: a lid 76 x 76 x 3 mm on four legs 8 x 8 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The legs stand on the fan's four corners, on a 50 mm square, and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: lift the lid 12 mm above the fan so the air leaves sideways.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Overall height from the top plate is 30 mm (fan 15, legs 12, lid 3).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A 4.4 mm hole runs down through each leg and the lid.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: four M4 x 40 pan-head screws from the top of the lid, through

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the legs, the fan's corner holes and the top plate, with nuts under

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the plate. Tighten lightly: the fan frame is plastic.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The lid edge stays 4 mm or more clear of the rods and spacers.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the lid sits level and the fan spins freely by hand.
